description: This PHP test class executes unit tests for EmployeeAttachment data access object (DAO) methods in the OrangeHRM project, including saving, retrieving, and deleting employee attachments, as well as handling invalid inputs.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the EmployeeAttachmentDao's CRUD operations in the OrangeHRM PIM module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creates an instance of EmployeeAttachmentDao, and populates test data fixtures.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee attachment and verifies that it persists correctly.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeAttachmentForFreshEmployee
methods.description: Tests saving an attachment for a new employee and verifies correct persistence.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeAttachmentWithId
methods.description: Tests saving an attachment with an explicitly set ID and verifies that it updates the existing record.

methods.name: testEmployeeAttachmentWithInvalidScreen
methods.description: Validates that setting an invalid screen value on the EmployeeAttachment triggers an InvalidArgumentException.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Checks retrieval of attachments for various screens for employee ID 1, asserting correct counts.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Tests fetching a specific employee attachment and verifying its properties, including decorator attachment content.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAttachmentWithoutScreen
methods.description: Tests fetching an attachment without specifying a screen and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Verifies that deleting multiple attachments by IDs for an employee and screen works as expected.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeAttachmentsWithWrongIdForScreen
methods.description: Tests deletion presence when some IDs do not match the employee's screen, verifying partial deletions.

methods.name: setDateTimeHelper
methods.description: Sets up a mock DateTimeHelperService returning a fixed date for predictable timestamp testing.
